title: A Parametric Study of the FitzHugh-Nagumo Reaction-Diffusion System
content: In this article we analyze a dynamical system known as the FitzHugh-Nagumo model, which offers many characteristics of nonlinear systems, such as bifurcation, excitability or limit cycle. The dynamics associated with sets of values of the parameters associated with this model, called excitable, oscillatory and bistable, are analyzed. Then adding a perturbing or diffusive term to the system through the Laplacian, it is studied how these dynamics propagate in a one-dimensional or two-dimensional extended medium, through the definition of a cellular automaton with periodic initial conditions.
